results.title: Dissolved oxygen rise after valve work
results.text: A step rise in dissolved oxygen at the point of use shortly after maintenance on a valve or fitting upstream suggests air ingress through a leaking diaphragm or seal. Check the work-order history for recent valve work on assets upstream of the point of use. Corrective action: re-inspect and re-seat or replace the diaphragm, leak-test, and flush.

results.title: AMC rising in a process bay
results.text: Compare AMC at the make-up air inlet with AMC in the bay. If the inlet is steady while the bay rises, the chemical filtration stage is the likely source.

results.title: RO membrane degradation
results.text: Ageing or fouled RO membranes pass more ions, so permeate conductivity rises and the load on downstream EDI and polishing stages increases. Check membrane runtime against rated life and the cleaning-in-place history. Corrective action: schedule cleaning or membrane replacement.

report.narrative: The dissolved oxygen reading at point of use measured 2.0553 ppb against the limit of 1.0 ppb, exceeding the allowed threshold. Sensor calibration was confirmed valid. The rate of change calculation showed a slope of 0.8026 ppb per hour over the past 120 minutes, with a mean first half of 1.4373 ppb and a mean second half of 2.1013 ppb. Work-order history reveals that VALVE_B_07 had a PVDF diaphragm valve replaced 9 hours ago on Loop B upstream of the point of use asset POU_ETCH_1. Knowledge base chunk UPW-06 links a step rise in dissolved oxygen shortly after upstream valve work to air ingress through a leaking diaphragm or seal. Resin and lamp runtimes show POLISH_B mixed-bed resin at 2300 hours out of 4500 rated hours (51.1 percent) and UV_B lamp at 5600 hours out of 8000 rated hours (70.0 percent), ruling out exhaustion and decay.
recommended_actions: Have a qualified engineer re-inspect and re-seat or replace the diaphragm on VALVE_B_07.
Perform a leak test and subsequent flush following diaphragm inspection.
Review upstream Loop B fittings for any additional signs of air ingress.
